Package neqsim.thermo.util.steam

Class CoolingWaterTransport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.util.steam.CoolingWaterTransport
public final class CoolingWaterTransport extends Object
Reference transport properties for liquid cooling water, with seawater salinity corrections.

Water uses IAPWS R12-08 Eqs. 11-12 and R15-11 Eqs. 16-17. Critical enhancement is omitted, appropriate for the 273.15-353 K cooling envelope, far from the critical region. Seawater uses the viscosity multiplier of Sharqawy et al. (2010), Eqs. 22-23, and the saline conductivity increment of IAPWS G10-15 (2015), Eqs. 1-5. The water reference is evaluated at the actual pressure. The viscosity multiplier was measured near atmospheric pressure; its use at higher pressure is an engineering extension. These are implementations of the published equations, not a redistribution of the MIT software.
